description: The website's pages grouped by type (pricing, alternatives, comparison, integrations, use cases, features, docs, blog, changelog, legal, home, other) from its sitemap, the pages people viewed and Search Console, with versioned path rules (classifier_version; each page names its rule). Per type: pages, visitors first seen in the range who landed there, signups, paying customers and net revenue per currency (never summed across currencies), Google clicks when Search Console is connected, and the top pages. gaps lists expected types that are missing or brought no visitors, as facts. Same period/from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot.

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: page_map
title: Revenue-page map
